meta.purpose: Guardrails found during explicit post-implementation audit. These rules prevent the prototype from recommending unsupported service access, arbitrary foreign carriers, or data-only products for a real-number requirement.

claude.note: Claude requires the user to be physically located in a supported location and requires a phone number from a supported location. Mainland China is not in Anthropic's current supported-location list. The tool must not present a foreign number as a workaround for an unsupported physical location.

openai-api.note: OpenAI currently limits ChatGPT/API access to supported countries and territories. Mainland China is not in the current supported-country list. The MVP must not recommend buying a foreign number to work around an unsupported physical location.

firstUsePolicy.label: First use outside the UK is explicitly listed as behavior to avoid
firstUsePolicy.note: giffgaff's current Fair Usage Policy lists using the service for the first time outside the UK among behaviors to avoid. This is a policy-risk warning, not a claim that activation is technically impossible.

communityObservation.label: Community exceptions exist, but are not the supported route
communityObservation.note: Some users report overseas activation under particular conditions. These are anecdotes only and do not override Tello's current requirement for first activation on US cellular towers.

sources.label: Reddit community report — overseas activation discussion

additionalRoutes.name: Destination local physical data SIM
additionalRoutes.form: physical SIM for mobile data; no phone number is assumed

cost.purchase: Destination-specific. Compare current physical-SIM data offers after choosing the destination.

retention.rule: This is a connectivity route, not a phone-number retention route.
retention.recovery: Keep a separate SMS-capable line if account recovery or OTP access matters.

friction.identity: KYC depends on the destination and seller.
friction.location: Purchase and activation rules depend on the destination product.
friction.device: Unlocked device with a compatible physical SIM slot and supported network bands.
friction.ongoing: Package expiry and data balance only; do not assume ordinary SMS capability.

local-data-physical.summary: Physical data-SIM purchase and activation depend on the destination seller/carrier.
local-data-physical.outsideHomeNote: This route is intentionally generic until a destination-specific physical data SIM is selected.

kyc.label: KYC depends on destination
kyc.note: Some physical data SIMs require identity checks and others do not; verify the exact destination product.

roamingSms.label: No ordinary SMS number assumed
roamingSms.note: This route is for mobile data. It must not be used as the SMS/OTP line in the recommendation.

wifiCallingAbroad.label: Can supply data for a separate line
wifiCallingAbroad.note: The data connection may support another SIM's Wi-Fi Calling/Text if that separate carrier and device support the configuration.
